topic: How does L-DACS integration impact spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links in congested airspaces?
consensus_response: The integration of L-DACS into congested airspaces affects spectrum sharing between A2G and satellite links through its frequency allocation and transmission techniques. FDD in L-DACS1 and TDD in L-DACS2 introduce specific spacing and array factor challenges, leading to increased interference and reduced capacity, especially in high-density areas. Proper interference mitigation and tight coordination are essential to optimize performance.
